code.reason: Experiment 7 changed only `robot_learning/scenario/training_environment.py` to oversample folded-required targets, and that recipe is contradicted: it did not improve the folded-required sector and degraded open-feasible behavior. The next experiment should begin from the `working` parent's complete scientific recipe rather than carrying the target mixture forward.

last_lineage_decision.reason: Experiment 7's 50/50 folded-required target mixture is contradicted. On the fresh 1000-episode panel seed 26000 the untouched `working` policy (checkpoint-100352) scored 97.10% (971/1000) while experiment-7 checkpoint-105472 scored 96.10% and checkpoint-120832 scored 94.80%; `working` won both paired comparisons (13 vs 3 and 25 vs 2 discordant wins), and the targeted folded-required sector was unchanged (working 25/54 = 46.3% versus 26/54 = 48.1% and 25/54 = 46.3%) while open-feasible success fell from 946/946 to 935/946 and 923/946. The run's own training proxy equalled the parent's folded ceiling rather than exceeding it, so exposure was not the binding constraint. No experiment-7 checkpoint is competitive with `working`, which remains the best measured policy at 4284/4400 = 97.36% pooled over seven distinct research panels, still below the 98% objective with all measured residual failures in the folded-required sector. Development continues from `working`; terminal assessment is not justified.
